item.title: Lenny Tavárez Launches Dale Ritmo Outreach With East Harlem Students & More Uplifting Moments in Latin Music
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our Latin music update. This week, we're celebrating some amazing moments in the world of Latin music. From birthday celebrations to World Cup announcements, let's dive in."
[Sound effects: Upbeat Latin music]
Host: "First up, happy birthday to Lenny Tavárez! The Puerto Rican star spent his special day launching his new community outreach initiative, Dale Ritmo, in East Harlem. He teamed up with his wife, Natasha Nazario, and Platoon to bring salsa dancing to students at the James Weldon Johnson School. Tavárez said, 'Seeing these students dance, learn and connect with their roots is the best birthday gift I could have received.'"
[Sound effects: Brief salsa music clip]
Host: "Meanwhile, Shakira is making headlines with an exciting announcement. She's invited the Ghetto Kids from Uganda to perform with her at the 2026 FIFA World Cup final halftime show in New Jersey. The child dance group went viral with their routine to Shakira's song 'Dai Dai,' and now they're getting the chance to shine on the world stage."
[Sound effects: Brief clip of "Dai Dai"]
Host: "And, soccer fans in Puerto Rico, rejoice! Rauw Alejandro is launching La Tribuna del Fútbol, a free fan experience that will run from June 11 to July 19. The event will feature live music, food, cultural activations, and daily screenings of World Cup matches. Plus, there will be tournaments and activities like padel, beach tennis, and bachata sessions."
[Sound effects: Upbeat music continues]
Host: "That's all for this week's Latin music update. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you next time with more exciting news and updates from the world of Latin music."
[Outro music plays]
